# Scala legacy upload DTO oracles

`scala_upload_dtos.json` is generated by `tools/GenerateLegacyUploadFixtures.java`
using the compiled repository `DSLegacyApiController.scala` DTO companions and
their derived `JsonAutoFormat` readers/writers, plus `DatasetUploadInfo` and
`ResumableUploadInfo` serialization. It covers default/optional/null fields,
manual reservation, conversion being discarded, linked layers and exact Play
validation error objects. For legacy directory-name lookup the oracle supplies
the explicit fixture ObjectId; HTTP tests separately verify authorization,
organization precedence, actual WK lookup and lookup avoidance for existing IDs.

The Java generator reproduces the controller's adaptation with the actual DTOs;
it does not run a Play server. Compile/run against
`webknossos-datastore/target/scala-3.8.4/classes` and the exported
`target/streams/compile/dependencyClasspath/_global/streams/export` classpath,
putting Java classes in a temporary directory. Capture stdout as this JSON.
Runtime needs neither Scala nor Java.

Actual Rust HTTP tests replay the ten cases, versions 10–13 upload contracts,
unversioned/versioned multipart chunks, old finish response fields, manual
reservation without Redis metadata, denied linked-layer/manual requests,
unfinished uploads and metadata across versions 10–16. Proxy/dataset/private-link
metadata downgrade safe largest segment IDs recursively while keeping larger
bigint envelopes, permissions, error codes, headers and tracingstore tokens.
